{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Silver Town |characters=シロガネタウン |japanese=Shirogane Town |image=Silver Town Johto.png |imagesize=280px |region=Johto |epicode=EP266 |episode=A Claim to Flame! }} '''Silver Town''' (Japanese: '''シロガネタウン''' ''Shirogane Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Johto]] [[region]]. It is situated at the base of [[Mt. Silver]] and its main attraction is the annual [[Silver Conference]]. At least 30 inhabitants are said to be living in the town. However, the population greatly increases during the Silver Conference, when the town receives several {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who successfully collected eight [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s from the region's [[Gym Leader]]s. There is an Athlete's Village, which consists of a huge [[Pokémon Center]] where Trainers participating in the tournament stay at for the duration of the event. There is also a stadium located nearby, where the Silver Conference matches officially take place. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} reached Silver Town in ''[[EP266|A Claim to Flame!]]'' so that Ash could participate in the Silver Conference.
